title: APICircle Folder
description: YAML projection of a single APICircle folder. Edits `name` and the optional folder-level `auth` block that descendant requests with `auth.type: inherit` resolve to. Identity (id / parentId) is intentionally not in the document — folder moves go through the TreeView drag-drop.

name.description: Folder name. Must be unique among siblings under the same parent — colliding renames are rejected on save.

auth.description: Optional folder-level auth. Any descendant request with `auth.type: inherit` resolves via `resolveInheritedAuth` (walks up the folder chain and uses the first explicit non-`inherit`, non-`none` auth it finds). Omit this section to leave folder-level auth unset; the inherit walk then continues up the chain.

type.description: Auth scheme. The remaining fields depend on the chosen type — see `RequestAuth` in `@apicircle/shared/types.ts` for the full discriminated union.
